title: Wind down loops when verification debt grows
narrative: Long loops accumulate verification debt; Fangore winds them down when independent verification age or repeated failures exceed host thresholds. Accepts WalkingLabs L13 guidance[^wl-l13-loop].
implementation: `LoopHealthSignals` and `should_wind_down` in `mechaharness.loop_health` expose verification-debt and failure signals.
